label: TP
reason: User input from getParameterValues directly flows into the LDAP filter string without any sanitization or escaping, reaching two sinks: ldap-injection via the filter execution and XSS via encodeForHTML output. The ESAPI encoder protects the attribute/street fields but not the filter itself which contains the unescaped user input, creating a genuine cross-site scripting vector through the error message display.

evidence.note: Unescaped user input in LDAP filter causes XSS via encoded error message
